description: Australian Road Assessment Program - AusRAP is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. AusRAP is the Australian Road Assessment Program. It is used to identify, manage and improve the safety of road infrastructure and roadside features to systematically and proactively reduce road trauma. AusRAP rates the risks and safety performance of Australia’s roads and is based on the globally recognised International Road Assessment Program (iRAP). Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Safer Roads, assessment, geospatial, rating, road. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, MAP. The portal shows 2025-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
